title: Know Before You Ship: Decision-Making and Customer Obsession in Fast-Paced Ecommerce
summary: Join a live ecommerce panel on September 30 to learn how to identify key signals for better product decisions and faster shipping.
body_markdown:
Hey everyone


👋


Quick one for anyone building, measuring, or growing an ecommerce product: every team can ship fast now. The real question is whether you can tell what's actually working.


Know Before You Ship: Signal, Decision-Making, and Customer Obsession in Ecommerce


📅


September 30, 2026 | 2PM BST | 40 mins + live Q&A It's a live panel with Hannah Bonney (Product Manager, Moonpig) and Dekel Moyal (Product Director, Global-E), moderated by Abla Alami at Mixpanel. They'll get into how they separate signal from noise as their teams move faster, and where judgment still matters more than speed. Bring your own question for the live Q&A.


[Register here](https://events.mixpanel.com/know-before-you-ship-ecommerce-emea/?utm_source=customerslackchannels&utm_medium=webinar&utm_campaign=WBN-26-08-12-KnowBeforeYouShip-EMEA-FM&utm_content=slack-promo-1) .
